summaries.en: Police have assigned the complaint regarding a perfect scorer's alleged cheating on the Law School Admission Test (LEET) to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Regional Investigation Unit and have begun an investigation.
summaries.zh: 警方已将针对法学专业能力考试 (LEET) 满分作弊嫌疑的举报案件移交给首尔地方警察厅广域搜查队并展开调查。

items.title: [속보] 이 대통령, 시진핑에 "서해 문제 근본해결 함께 노력하자"

summaries.ko: 이재명 대통령이 한중 정상회담에서 시진핑 주석에게 서해 문제의 근본적인 해결을 위해 함께 노력할 것을 제안했다.
summaries.en: During a South Korea-China summit, President Lee Jae-myung proposed to President Xi Jinping that they work together for a fundamental resolution of the West Sea issue.
summaries.zh: 在韩中峰会上，李在明总统向习近平主席提议，两国应共同努力从根本上解决西海问题。
